decisions: Use opcode-specific positional binary payloads in wire v2.
Use integer microseconds and bytes at the transport boundary.
Retain wire v1 and raw JSONL as isolated compatibility modes.
Preserve a client session only after recoverable runtime-event rejection.
Keep the native hook ring ABI separate from FluidLink.
Defer delta state until repeated snapshot bodies exist.
Defer generic shared memory until synchronization and benchmark gates pass.
